title: MIT Summer Research Program (MSRP)
institution: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), Office of Graduate Education
about: The MIT Summer Research Program (MSRP) brings undergraduates enrolled at U.S. institutions to MIT for summer research from 7 June to 7 August 2027. Applications close 19 January 2027 at 11:59 PM ET; a 3.5 minimum GPA applies.
requirements: Full-time enrolment at a U.S. institution as a sophomore, junior or non-graduating senior
International students on F-1 visas need CPT or OPT approval by 15 May 2027
Recommendation letters must arrive by the 19 January 2027 deadline

upskill.name: AI for Research & Information Synthesis
why: Field "Research across MIT disciplines" → objective "Use AI to explore, organize, and structure information collected from multiple documents or professional sources."
Program "summer research" for undergraduates → objective "Transform complex information into research briefs, comparison matrices, executive summaries, and actionable recommendations."
